setlist.title: It's All Over Now, Baby Blue

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Minglewood Blues** (2 reviews): Reviewer dislikes Weir's slide guitar playing on Minglewood, calling it a lesson in how not to play slide; Reviewer, a guitarist, agrees Weir's slide playing on Minglewood was among the worst he'd seen live [14][24]
- **The Other One** (2 reviews): Reviewer calls the jam out of Space into The Other One amazing; audience video shows Weir playing intensely; Reviewer highlights the Other One and its jam, plus Wharf Rat, and a Around>Sugar Magnolia closer [15][16]
- **Jack Straw** (1 review): Reviewer describes a high-energy Jack Straw opener that gets the show going [22]
- **Let It Grow** (1 review): Reviewer ranks this Let It Grow among the top three, with a killer Phil bass line [15]
- **Terrapin Station** (1 review): Reviewer enjoyed the Terrapin and found Hell in a Bucket decent [21]
- **Drums** (1 review): Reviewer found Drums>Space overly long, and some sections dragged [21]
- **The Other One intro jam** (1 review): The jam before the first verse is hot, with a brief clear James Bond theme quote from Brent [20]
- **It's All Over Now, Baby Blue** (1 review): Reviewer describes the Baby Blue as bittersweet [16]

## Setlist highlights

- **Bob & Brent Jam**: rare: 4 archived performances [25]
- **The Other One intro jam**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [25]

## The recordings

- **gd1983-09-18.aud.andrewf.79375.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 19 songs; 155 min; rated 4.6/5 by 5 [1]
- **gd1983-09-18.163460.nak700.wagner.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 17 songs; 161 min [2]
- **gd83-09-18.sbd.dodd.17409.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 17 songs; 156 min; rated 3.24/5 by 17 [6]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the sound good and praises Lesh's rubbery, warm low-end bass [14]
- **gd1983-09-18.163784.senn421.vita.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 17 songs; 155 min [7]
- **gd1983-09-18.nak700.guch.poris.russjcan.98307.flac16**: source not stated; 16 songs; 153 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [11]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says Phil is very defined in the recording and the mix is very good [22]

## Around the show

- Reviewer's aunt and uncle, Deadheads, attended this show [16]
- Attendee recalls a lawn venue among giant pines, blue sky, a few clouds, Anchor Steam on tap, and many vendors [23]
- Attendee felt Jerry was clearly feeling it during the second set [23]
- The Other One space is included within The Other One track [2]
- Reviewer says many Dead shows are better, but this one is solid and might win over skeptics of 1983-86 [14]
- Reviewer suggests this may be among the top five 1983 shows [15]
- Reviewer says the show runs at breakneck speed all night, almost too fast in places [22]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1983-09-18.aud.andrewf.79375.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Andrew F; transferred by Andrew F; source: 2 Sony ECM-220 mics + 1 Sony ECM-939LT (stereo) mic > Sony MX-10L 4-channel mixer > Marantz PMD-340 cassette deck. Taped on Maxell UDXL-II 90's, Dolby on. Mics… [1]. Also: Audience-source version patched with bits from ShnID-7225 in Drums, Sugar Magnolia and Baby Blue, with pitch adjusted -0.3 semitone [1]
- **gd1983-09-18.163460.nak700.wagner.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Bob Wagner; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Bob Wagner's Master Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 700 mics > Sony D5 [2]. Also: Master cassette source came from Bob Wagner, transferred by Charlie Miller; Sennheiser 421 source from Jim Vita patches Drums and Sugar Magnolia [2]
- **gd83-09-18.sbd.dodd.17409.sbeok.shnf**: source: MSC>Cass>DAT>CDR Eac > cool edit pro > shntool > cdwav > shnv3 Discs kindly provided by Andy Lemieux Eac > shn by Ernie Dodd [6]
- **gd1983-09-18.163784.senn421.vita.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Jim Vita; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Master Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser 421 mics > Jim Vita's 1st Generation Cassettes [7]. Also: Bob Wagner's Nakamichi 700 source supplies most of Jack Straw and a short patch in Space [7]
- **gd1983-09-18.nak700.guch.poris.russjcan.98307.flac16**: taped by Tazuo Yamaguchi and Jamie Poris; transferred by Russ Cansler; source: Nakamichi 700's with Sony TC-D5 FOB DFC Maxell XL-IIs 90 nr dbx II [11]
